nodes.title: What the child hears in a throttled minute, 14.2's 429 overflow (2c2273f on f058080e; evals/latency/overflow-arm.mjs): the eastus2 host stubbed to an instant 429, the southindia twin answering for real, US container, interleaved, n = 20 per arm, paired deltas with bootstrap 90% CIs. Reply lane (taxila-fast, the 2.2 s hedge), whole reply p50/p90 1219/1577 -> 2315/3170 ms, +988 ms [636, 1323], 20/20 answered (before 14.2: the fallback line); 31 southindia calls for 20 replies (11 hedge twins doubled onto the overflow; main removing). Agent lane (taxila-gpt6 JSON stream, say first): first speakable clause 1433/1925 -> 1795/2540 ms, +319 ms [235, 524]; whole call 1758/2481 -> 2248/2842, +459 ms [97, 673]; one overflow call each.

The 429 overflow arm re-run on 14.2 c61f728c (main's fixes from stream 3's review: first-attempt 429 only, one move per hedged call, speculation and background never move), same method, ~08:20 UTC, n = 20 per arm interleaved: reply lane whole p50/p90 1403/1730 -> 2518/3191 ms, +747 ms [449, 1267], 20 southindia calls for 20 throttled replies (was 31: the hedge twins no longer double onto it), 20/20 answered. Agent lane (taxila-gpt6 JSON stream, unchanged by the fix) first clause 1654/2429 -> 2483/2974 ms, +868 ms [649, 1029] (was +319 [235, 524] at ~07:45 UTC): the southindia twin's own latency varies by the hour; the normal arm was slower too (+221 ms p50). Plan on +0.3 to +0.9 s for her first clause in a throttled minute, not the +349 ms TTFT on record.

The continuer's positive gate tuned after the sim lab's 14.2 voice arm (f058080e, n = 32: every safety / leaving / relational target 0, but ordinary turns 35/376 got one vs 63/174 before; ack_natural 3.75 vs 3.94). (1) ABSOLUTE words stay absolute: romance, companion, exclusivity, secrecy, are-you-real, insults, out of bounds, an adult at the device, tiredness, time LEFT, leaving, home and family, the child's own results; liking HER is absolute only with a person object (aap / tum / you near pasand / like / love). (2) Talk TO HER (aap / tum / you) is refused unless the turn has lesson words or working aloud (never excused by a bare number or a question word: "aap kaise ho", "aapne Pushpa 2 dekhi?"). (3) Other soft words (time, minute, kitna, screens, sport) are excused by any lesson shape, now including Devanagari spoken numbers (grading/spoken-number.js numberPhrases, "ek" alone not counted), working aloud, counting, guessing, "you asked". (4) A clean reading (no flag, no request) of words with nothing soft is allowed: her own "what do you like?" answered. Battery (conversation-v2): 79/84 lesson-intent lines get one; 0/74 off-lesson lines on words alone; 15/52 grey lines (off-lesson curiosity, cycle, 'mushkil hai') on a clean reading. A contest ('nahi mera answer sahi hai') stays refused: an 'Okay…' would read as conceding. Reverse if: the sim lab's voice-cont re-run puts any continuer on a safety, leaving or relational turn.

The agent lane's speculated call (stream 3's server/latency/agentSpec.js on 4A's agentSpeculate / agentCallOf key, 93334bd8): her model call started on the device prefetch once its classify (and the understanding note) settled clean, adopted by the turn only on an identical input key. turn-e2e --turn-audio --prefetch, prod routing, TEST, effort none, class 4, n = 10 turns: adopted 7/7 speculable turns (3 were requests: not speculated), 0 wrong adoptions, 0 spoken drafts; but it started only 0-81 ms ahead of the turn's own call. The prefetch leads the turn by ~0.3-0.6 s and its classify takes about as long, so both reach 'classify settled' together. Before the take waited for a pending start of the same words, 7/8 turns missed (the turn arrived while the last prefetch's classify was still settling). A turn whose deltas changed started two calls, one wasted.

The agent lane's speculated call ships OFF (TAXILA_AGENT_SPEC=on to enable): the mechanism is correct (7/7 adopted, never a wrong or spoken draft) but saves ~0 ms at the measured prefetch lead and costs an extra model call on turns whose deltas change. Reverse if: the prefetch's lead over the turn grows past classify's time (e.g. a slower STT completion or an earlier stable partial), measured as speculation 'ahead' >= 300 ms at p50.

14.3.1 (main merged 69542351): the acknowledgement is visible in the flight recorder, codes only. Server: one `ack.decision` row per decision on a lesson (sid = the lesson), built by the pure ackDecisionRow (server/latency/routes.js): kind echo | continuer, or none = one of 21 closed gate reasons (anything else 'other'), decidedMs, shadow, audio, continuerAsked, cohort, ms; never the child's words, the phrase or the echo's token; tier 1, no blob. Device: one `ack.outcome` per decided clip (played | reply_first | late | mismatched | interrupted, afterStopMs). docs/design/round5/results/latency/ack-cohort-query.sql reads them over real-lesson sids only. Why: with the continuer on for the owner cohort, a continuer on a safety turn could not be seen in production. Reverse if: a row is ever found carrying words (then fix the builder, do not drop the trace).

The 44 'relational' continuer refusals on ordinary turns in the sim lab's 63bf58d6 voice arm, each attributed offline: 17 right (time left, tired, stop, bored + game ask, are-you-real, best friend + secret, girlfriend, talk to or complaints about her), 4 reason_given mixed with tired / contest / share (right), about 16 lesson content hitting a word meant for something else (paani/water x5, ghar x3, 'oxygen chhodte', 'empty nahi hoga', 'maza aata hai', 'rabbit is so cute', 'staff thak jaayenge', 'mummy bolti hain', 'poora insaan', Minecraft), 3 not reproducible offline (the transcript differs from the scripted line). The third pass (main agreed, AFTER the owner cohort's day on this gate): paani only as a break, ghar soft, chhod / nahi hoga / thak first-person or giving-up only, maza only with nahi, cute only with a person object; each with a test pair (the over-refused line passes, the meant line still refuses); romance / secrecy / are-you-real untouched; then a fresh sim-lab arm. Expected ~12 of 44 recovered.

tests/p3-voicesig-client 'never delay the turn' failed 1 in 3 alone and under every loaded gate. Not a product delay: its < 200 ms bound timed the harness's speak() (synthesising ~6 s of frames: 169-252 ms on a loaded 4-core container), while the child's final -> the turn request took 2-4 ms. Fixed (3b1e317d, queued for 14.4) to prove ORDER: the slow detector's run is held open by the test and the turn must already be sent while it is pending. Spread: whole file 10/10 alone; under 3 CPU-busy loops the old version failed 4/8 runs, the new one 0/8; full gate 3375/0.
